7.name: Ultimate Cooking Challenge Begins

7.overview: Cooks dive into a fierce cooking battle with unmatched ingredients while comalis bring nonstop fun to the heated challenge. Stay tuned for surprises and intense moments!

7.overview: Laughter explodes as Ma Ka Pa and Rakshan unveil a mass cooking challenge. Later, cooks give their Comalis a wacky vegetable makeover for the ultimate win.

7.name: Fun-Filled Parotta Challenge
7.overview: Entertainment peaks as cooks and Comalis face a crazy Parotta challenge. Excitement builds further as the team of the movie, Idhayam Murali visits, sparking non-stop laughter.

7.name: The Countdown to Elimination
7.overview: The stars of the movie, Idhayam Murali shake up the kitchen, guiding Comalis over a phone task. Cooks rush through their plating for scores before a tough eviction.

7.overview: A grand Junior vs Senior showdown begins as previous finalists compete against the current season chefs. The teams face traditional tasks, including a masala grinding challenge.

7.overview: The cooking battle gets fierce as senior and junior teams take on the Gramathu Samayal challenge. Witness cooks overcome challenges with traditional village equipment to cook.

7.overview: Contestants grab their partners for a fierce seafood battle. Soon, the kitchen heats up as contestants race against time in a special potato-based culinary task demonstrated by the chef.

7.overview: The seafood challenge heats up as cooks and Comalis race to prepare authentic coastal dishes. Seniors and Juniors impress the judges with their regional seafood creations.

7.overview: Rakshan unveils the Heritage theme as teams select Comalis. Ma Ka Pa and Ramar bring non-stop laughs before a tough flour-sieving advantage challenge tests everyone!

7.overview: An impressive cooking battle celebrates treats from Kurinji, Mullai, Neithal, and Marudham lands. Great anticipation builds as cooks present regional flavours with pride.

7.name: Flower Omelette Challenge
7.overview: Cooks and Comalis gear up for the International Cuisine Battle with airport ticket pairings. The fun begins as they compete in the flower-shaped omelette advantage task.

7.name: International Flavours Battle
7.overview: The International Cuisine round concludes with outstanding dishes from the junior and senior teams. Anxiety grips the contestants as the elimination unfolds for both teams.

7.name: Mothers Join Advantage Challenge
7.overview: Cooks and Comalis join their mothers for a hilarious Advantage Challenge. The teams struggle with a fun baby task, while Team Niram graces the show.

7.name: A Motherly Feast Unfolds
7.overview: The cooking battle takes an emotional turn as contestants prepare special dishes for their mothers. Tears overflow as they lovingly feed them, expressing their deep gratitude.

7.name: Cooks Create a Fun Twist
7.overview: The show opens with a surprise as Comalis choose their cooks while they perform entertaining get-up roles. The fun continues as they pick ingredients using their cooks' clues.

7.name: Flavours Across Borders
7.overview: Teams take on Northeast and Sri Lankan dishes while tackling Comali challenges. Guest stars add to the fun as Chef Koushik awards the Golden Apron to the week's top performer.

7.name: Ultimate Semi-Finals Battle Begins!
7.overview: The cooking battle turns fierce as contestants enter semi-finals, with Comalis in spooky getups pairing with Cooks. Fun takes over as Comalis face a crazy watermelon challenge.

7.name: Who Will Reach the Grand Finale?
7.overview: Celebrity guests join a thrilling semifinal packed with cuisine challenges and fun tasks. As contestants race to impress the judges, who will emerge as the grand finalists?

7.name: One Final Step to Victory
7.overview: The finalists reflect on their journey, cherished moments and challenges throughout the season. The countdown to the finale begins, wait and watch to see who emerges as winner!

7.name: Grand Finale Showdown!
7.overview: The grand finale kicks off with guest visits, hilarious comali picks, and high-stakes cooking. As tension rises, previous winners and judges brace to crown the champion!

7.overview: Comalis deliver non-stop laughs as Ramar shines as Neelambari, dances with Pugazh, and steals moments with Roja. Semi-final madness peaks as top awards are crowned!

overview: Cooku with Comali, also known by the acronym CWC, is an Indian Tamil-language comedy-based cooking competition show aired on Star Vijay and streams on Disney+ Hotstar where the contestants are paired each week with comedians (comalis) who are amateur cooks. The first season premiered on 16 November 2019 and ended on 23 February 2020. The second season was premiered on 14 November 2020 and ended on 14 April 2021. The third season was premiered on 22 January 2022 and ended on 24 July 2022. The contestants along with their comalis are challenged every week and judged by Chef Damu and Chef Venkatesh Bhat.
